summary: Abuhamdieh explicitly rejected AIPAC-aligned funding for his 2026 Berkeley City Council campaign. CAIR Action endorsed him and Vote for Peace rated him Ally in the general election, both organizations that assess candidates on Gaza and war-lobby funding. The Bay Area Muslim Council supported him at rank one, though its stated comment addressed local business concerns rather than foreign policy.
